description:
Browser API Client is a REST client and API tester that opens in a full browser tab — a lightweight Postman alternative with no account, no desktop app and no cloud sync. Build an HTTP request, press Send, read the response. Nothing is lost when you click away.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Send any HTTP request — GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS — to any API, without CORS getting in the way.
- Build requests fast — a URL bar synced with query params, headers with suggestions, and bodies: JSON, URL-encoded form, multipart with file uploads, raw text, binary file and GraphQL.
- Authenticate — Bearer token, Basic auth, API key (header or query), and OAuth 2.0 client credentials. Tokens stay on your device and refresh automatically.
- Read responses clearly — status, timing and size; pretty JSON with a collapsible tree and search; image and sandboxed HTML preview; a hex view and download for binary.
- Test without scripts — check the status, headers, JSON paths, body text and response time of every response.
- Chain requests — copy a token or an id from one response into {{variables}} for the next request.
- Run a collection — send a collection or folder in order, see pass/fail for each request, and re-run only the failures.
- Stay organized — collections with folders, multiple request tabs, history grouped by day, and environments for dev, staging and production with secret values masked.
- Import — paste a cURL command, an OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 spec, a Postman v2.1 collection or environment, or a HAR file.
- Export — collections to Postman v2.1, and code snippets for cURL, JavaScript fetch, Node.js axios, Python requests, Go, PHP, C# and HTTPie.
- Watch Server-Sent Events arrive live.
- Work from the keyboard — Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends, Cmd/Ctrl+S saves, and ? lists every shortcut. Light and dark themes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no sign-in and no pairing with a desktop app — ever.
- No tracking and no analytics. Your requests, tokens, collections and history are stored only in your browser.
- Requests go straight from your browser to the API you choose, and only when you press Send or run a collection.
- Backups are plain JSON files that you export and import yourself.

Built by Brightbar (brightbar.dev).
single_purpose: An API client: build and send HTTP requests to APIs the user chooses and inspect the responses, with the tools that support that one purpose (request tabs, history, environments, collections, tests, import and code export).

permission_justifications.storage: Saves the user's work on the device: open request tabs (drafts), request history, environments, collections, OAuth 2.0 tokens and settings. Nothing is synced or sent anywhere.
permission_justifications.host_permissions: Core function. The user sends HTTP requests to API endpoints they enter, on any domain, so the extension needs access to all hosts to send those requests without CORS restrictions and to read the complete response. Requests are sent only when the user presses Send or runs a collection. The extension injects no content scripts and does not read or change the pages the user browses.
